_doc: Site display settings. Percentile thresholds decide when a stat's title (or its flip) is awarded on a player page.

home._doc: Hall of fame: featured_count achievements drawn at random on each page load. Records: big guild cards built from meta.guild_bosses; `kind` is most_kills, most_wipes, fastest_kill or slowest_kill.

player._doc: Player page layout. Overview tiles come first; their stats are left out of the category sections. In each category, up to featured_per_category stats at or above featured_min_pct (or deep in flip territory) get a big card; the rest are small cards, visible_small of them shown before a 'Show more' button. An overview tile shows the percentile bar when its stat is ranked in percentile, unless its `percentile` flag says otherwise.
